question:
Select the word that is closest in meaning (SYNONYM) to the word given below.

DEPRESSED
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Doleful'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Depressed" -** In English, "depressed" is an adjective that refers to someone who is in a state of general unhappiness or despondency, often as a result of mental or emotional strain or difficulty.(उदास)
 
• **"Doleful" -** This is an adjective in English that describes a feeling or expressing great sadness.(उदास)
 
• **"Doleful"** has a** very similar meaning** to **"depressed",** as it can refer to someone who is in a state of melancholy or sorrow.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is: **'Doleful'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Dynamic" -** This is an adjective that describes something that is characterized by constant change, activity, or progress. (गतिशील)
 
• **"Sturdy" -** This is an adjective that describes something or someone as being strongly and solidly built. (मजबूत).
 
• **"Noisy" - **This adjective describes something that is making or given to making a lot of noise. (शोरीला).
